title: Holes
alt: If you're thinking 'Wait, a giant crystal cave in Mexico? What's that?' then I'm SO excited for the image search you're about to do.
transcript:
[A large graph is shown,  displaying various features of the world on a flat scale. Various holes on it are labelled.]
[Title of Graph:] Holes
Elevation is to scale relative to sea level and ground level
Land shapes and horizontal distances are not to scale
explanation:
This comic is a comparison of some of the largest holes in the world, both manmade and natural, showing how high/deep they are, relative to both sea level and the local surface. It is somewhat unusual to refer to many of these as 'holes' — what counts as a hole can be something of a vexed question. Holes could refer to artificial boreholes or natural deep areas, such as the  or the .

This comic appears to be related to 1040: Lakes and Oceans.
